caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile with a pattern of alternating squares and rectangles in red and beige. The textile consists of a repeating geometric design, with red threads forming distinct grid-like and checkered patterns on a beige or cream-colored background. The right and bottom edges of the textile are adorned with a row of red fringe, which is knotted and hangs down in tassels. The rest of the textile's border is straight and clean, without fringes. The entire textile is presented on a plain, off-white background, emphasizing the woven structure and the contrast between the red and beige areas.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
